3,037 likes, 123 comments - sanyamalhotra_ on September 28, 2026: "Spent a lovely day at Godrej Nest, and I’m so glad I got to be part of the Shubh Aarambh celebrations by Godrej Properties ❤️ 

What made it especially memorable was getting to surprise a family as they stepped into their new home for the very first time. Seeing their reaction and being part of that moment was truly unforgettable.

I also loved experiencing the idea behind Godrej Nest, Life, On Your Time, 24x7 because life doesn’t always follow a fixed schedule, and I love the thought of having a home that gives you the freedom to live at your own pace.

Grateful to have been part of such a beautiful beginning. Here’s to new homes, new memories and many more chapters ahead. ✨

@godrejpropertiesltd
@godrejproperties_north

#GodrejProperties #GodrejNest #ShubhAarambh #LifeOnYourTime #ad".
